registrations.name: Markov Blanket Room
registrations.description: A cubic lattice classified into internal cells, blanket cells and external cells, built at room scale so a body stands inside the interior. It does not draw a membrane and call it a boundary: a breadth-first search runs from the centre, blocked by blanket cells only, and asks whether any path reaches the rim. The verdict plate reports SEPARATED or REACHED, and when a path exists it is drawn in full. leak removes blanket cells (sealed, pinhole, breach, dissolved) and shell decides how the boundary was built at all (shell, patchy, double, none). patchy is the instructive value: a boundary with a third of its cells missing usually still separates, because separation is about paths and not about coverage. The search result is readable from code via is_separated() and escape_path_length(), so the claim can be checked without reading pixels.
